title: Nigeria Telecom Data Quality Audit: Reproducible ISO/IEC 25012 Assessment and TR-DQGF
description: Reproducibility package for a standards-based audit of Nigerian public telecommunications workbooks covering Q2 2024 to Q4 2025. The package contains the final V3 Python audit script, methodological metadata and machine-readable derived audit outputs, and accompanies a manuscript proposing the Telecom Regulatory Data Quality Governance Framework (TR-DQGF).
